mechanism: EUR/USD is the pricing anchor of the dollar board: the deepest USD pair and the ~57.6% weight of the dollar index, so dealer inventory and risk systems mark the whole USD complex off the EUR/USD quote. When EUR/USD reprices by a large standardized amount within one session, every other USD pair's quote is momentarily stale relative to the EUR-implied dollar level. The forced actors are inventory-constrained dealers: their GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD and NZD books are hedged against a USD position whose mark just moved; quote re-centering executes under inventory and latency constraints, and in a multi-dealer market the re-centering propagates dealer-to-dealer over more than one session (dealer inventory and quote revision dynamics: Ho & Stoll 1981 JFinE; order flow and information diffusion across FX pairs: Evans & Lyons 2002 JF; microstructure of FX quote setting: Lyons 2001; common-factor structure that makes the dollar board cohere: Lustig, Roussanov & Verdelhan 2011 RFS). Systematic relative-value funds re-center crosses with capacity-constrained lag for the same reason. The mechanism under test is the NEXT-NEXT-session tail of this diffusion: at the daily 16:00-NY clock with the mandatory one-event lag, the testable claim is that after a large EUR/USD repricing day t (completed bar), the six follower pairs continue to re-center in the EUR direction over the move from the t+1 close to the t+2 close — the slow inventory tail that thick pairs absorb in session t+1 but the full board completes only later. Quantitative law, frozen: at the completion instant of each daily 16:00-NY bar t, r_L = ln(close_t / close_{t-1}) of EUR/USD; sigma = the standard deviation of EUR/USD daily log returns over the trailing 120 completed NY-days strictly before t; z = r_L / sigma. The trigger fires iff |z| >= 2.0. Direction: each follower's non-USD currency moves WITH the EUR sign against the dollar — EUR-up (z > 0): LONG GBP/USD, LONG AUD/USD, LONG NZD/USD, SHORT USD/JPY, SHORT USD/CHF, SHORT USD/CAD; EUR-down (z < 0): all six mirrored. Enter all six legs flat at the open of the next session's 16:00-NY bar (one-event lag) and hold exactly one NY-day (exit at the following bar). Who is forced to act: dealers re-centering stale quotes and lagged relative-value systems; when it must fail: if cross-pair arbitrage completes the re-centering within the first post-trigger session, the t+1->t+2 drift is zero and the anchor earns nothing but cost — the falsification is live, not decorative.
falsifiable_prediction: (i) The six-leg follower basket earns positive after-cost financing-adjusted expectancy over the t+1 -> t+2 window after |z| >= 2.0 EUR/USD days, with the price-only book not inverting the anchor expectancy sign; (ii) incremental alpha versus the stale-leader benchmark (identical law with the leader read at t-10 NY-days, staleness strictly exceeding the 1-2-session diffusion window) is strictly > 0 — fresh leader information, not the trading law alone, must carry the value; (iii) the sign-shuffled causal control (identical trigger days, legs, holds, clocks and costs, with each leg's direction flipped on a frozen deterministic ~50% hash-parity schedule) must NOT reproduce the edge under its preregistered rule — if it fires, the leader's signed move is not the operative ingredient and the family fails regardless of the anchor's sign; (iv) the inherited USD-drift diagnostic is a preregistered falsifier of the dollar-momentum explanation: if the book's PnL is just next-day dollar-trend continuation, |corr(daily PnL, USD-wide move)| exceeds the frozen 0.30 ceiling and USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR fires; (v) all inherited Stage-A gates pass with the tier-2.0 stress book as a primary gate.

universe.leader_pair: EUR/USD (information source ONLY — never traded as a leg)
universe.subset_justification: Causal, decided ex ante: the followers are exactly the authorized pairs other than the leader — the full dollar board whose common mark EUR/USD anchors. No cherry-picking is possible (nothing is excluded on any outcome ground); the leader/leg split is the mechanism's design, not a subset choice. Six traded legs also keep the inherited pair-concentration gate (max 0.40 share of gross positive PnL) structurally passable (floor 0.167), which a 2-3 leg design would violate by arithmetic.

decision_clock: DAILY: one decision per pair per NY trading day at the completion instant of the 16:00 America/New_York flat bar (20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST via zoneinfo; DST-aware, never fixed offsets; DST 16:00-NY calendar invariants inherited). Session gate Sun 21:00 America/New_York -> Fri 16:00 New York; no weekend decisions or fills. Daily-or-slower satisfied; no intraday decision anywhere.
warmup: 121 completed valid NY-days of 16:00-NY closes for the leader AND every follower (120-day sigma window plus the leader return day) strictly before the first decision; a day is valid only if the completed bar exists for every used pair — any missing bar voids that day's decision (NO_EVAL, fail-closed, never fill-forward).
features_and_lags: All features are completed 16:00-NY bars strictly before the decision instant (a completed bar is available at its completion instant by construction; availability-lagged trivially — no stamp-bearing series is used). Leader return r_L at t uses closes t and t-1; sigma uses closes strictly before t. No print value, policy variable or clock series enters any feature.
entry_rules: On trigger day t (|z| >= 2.0 at the completed bar): if a leg is flat, enter its frozen direction at the open of the next session's 16:00-NY bar (one-event lag). If a leg is already in a position, the new trigger is ignored for that leg (no refresh, no extension). Governor: max 1 position per pair, max 1 entry per pair per NY-day; blocked signals are NO_TRADE, never deferred. All six legs act on the same trigger day as one frozen basket.
exit_rules: Exit each leg at the open of the 16:00-NY bar after the 1st completed NY-day following entry (fixed 1-NY-day horizon). No profit target, no stop, no time extension, no signal refresh while a leg is open. Force-flat: any open leg exits at the open of the 16:00-NY bar of the last decision day before a fold boundary; a trade spanning an internal boundary is refused (FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION). Missing entry/exit bar => signal voided or earliest-scheduled exit, never fill-forward.
fill_convention: One-event lag: decision at completed bar t, fill at the next session's 16:00-NY bar, never same-bar (ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION inherited); a fill gap exceeding 4 calendar days over holiday weekends fails closed to NO_TRADE (inherited validator constraint). Fill prices are the fill bar's open; DST-aware bar stamps 20:00Z/21:00Z.

anchor.spec: Exactly the frozen mechanism law: |z| >= 2.0 one-session EUR/USD trigger, six-leg EUR-anchored direction map, next-session entry, 1-NY-day hold, governor, force-flat folds, dual book.

neighbour.one_presumption_away: Swaps only the repricing-speed presumption ('a large single-session EUR move captures the dollar-board repricing event') for a two-session cumulative version: z is computed on (r_t + r_{t-1}) standardized by the same trailing 120-day sigma, same |z| >= 2.0, everything else byte-identical. If the diffusion mechanism is real, the neighbour moves TOGETHER with the anchor (same verdict sign, similar fold pattern); divergence means the trigger sits on a knife-edge between session-count definitions and the family is not promotable.
neighbour.spec: Byte-identical to anchor EXCEPT the trigger standardized return is the 2-NY-day cumulative leader return; same legs, map, holds, clocks, costs, dual book.

control.role: Sign-shuffled causal control: destroys exactly the operative ingredient — the SIGNED leader information — while holding the trigger days, leg set, clocks, holds, costs, governor and dual book identical. For each triggered (decision, pair) entry, the direction is flipped iff SHA-256('{decision_ts}|{pair}|FXFV5-A6-P2-CTRL') is even (a frozen deterministic schedule; ~50% of legs flipped on every trigger day by hash parity). The control's expected gross expectancy is structurally zero-minus-costs, so it can only match the anchor if the anchor's PnL does not depend on the leader's direction (direction-irrelevant exposure, cost artifacts, or a volatility-harvest form).
control.disclosed_leakage: The control retains the trigger-day selection (active-EUR days), so any 'event-day exposure' component common to anchor and control affects both; that is intentional — it makes the control a pure test of signed-information content, and the preregistered rule kills the family if the sign does not matter.
control.runs_to_completion: Yes: price-only law on authorized pairs; every control decision has an observable; the book executes under evidenced semantics with the same fail-closed rules as the anchor (the V3R lesson — a control that cannot execute has null evidentiary value — is respected).
control.preregistered_non_reproduction_rule: The control REPRODUCES (and the family FAILS its control gate regardless of the anchor's sign) if control financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND control PF >= 1.10, OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy. Positive raw control PnL never overrides a firing control; the kernel's mechanism_sanity definition governs where its label differs from this prose.

incremental_test.benchmark_definition: Per the frozen benchmark_treatment convention (freshness removed, everything else identical): the anchor law with the leader read STALE — r_L from NY-day t-10 and sigma ending at t-11 (staleness 10 NY-days strictly exceeds the 1-2-session diffusion window, so the benchmark's entries arrive after the window under test has closed). Identical legs, direction map, clocks, holds, fills, costs, folds.
incremental_test.gate: Overall incremental alpha > 0: anchor financing-adjusted expectancy minus benchmark financing-adjusted expectancy, evaluated under the same gates as the anchor. Positive raw anchor PnL never overrides a failed incremental alpha. The benchmark is an auxiliary treatment inside the anchor cell, not a fourth scored arm.

drop_one_design.procedure: This family trades 6 of the 7 authorized pairs (the leader is the excluded pair), so the kernel's 7-pair 8-scenario dropout is adapted family-side as in V4: 6 leg-drops (each excluding exactly one follower; the basket renormalizes to 5 legs with the frozen map unchanged) + the inherited drop-one-BEST-fold = 7 scenarios. Dropping the LEADER (EUR/USD) is structurally vacuous (empty trigger set) and is excluded from the suite — disclosed; the kernel's DROPOUT definition governs where labels differ.
drop_one_design.gate: Anchor financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.00 in at least 6 of 7 scenarios (proportional tightening of the inherited 6/8 rule to the 7-scenario design).
drop_one_design.non_vacuity: Each leg-drop changes the basket composition and the per-leg book by construction; asserted at implementation as a test.
drop_one_design.interpretation: Failure means the edge is a single-leg artifact (e.g. one currency's episode), not a board-wide re-centering mechanism.

dual_book_and_financing.financing_gate: The financing term must not manufacture the edge: the price-only book must not invert the sign of the anchor's expectancy (FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE inherited gate). This family is price-only in its signal.

falsification_rule: The family FAILS (terminal, no post-observation tuning of threshold, sigma window, legs, map, holds or clocks) if ANY of: (i) anchor financing-adjusted expectancy <= 0, or PF < 1.10, or any inherited Stage-A gate fails (margin-to-fail recorded per gate, P-2); (ii) CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM: sign-shuffled control fin-adj expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.10, OR control expectancy >= 0.5 x anchor expectancy — the leader's signed move is not operative; (iii) USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR: |corr(daily PnL, USD-wide move)| > 0.30 (evaluated per kernel when >= 60 days) — the edge is next-day dollar momentum, not cross-pair re-centering; (iv) incremental alpha <= 0 vs the stale-leader benchmark; (v) NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR per kernel mechanism_sanity; (vi) any MDD / fold-population / concentration / dropout / stress-tier-2.0 / financing gate failure.
failure_interpretation: Negative anchor expectancy after base cost: large EUR repricings carry no after-cost next-next-session diffusion into the dollar board at the frozen cost authority — a complete, publishable reject with break-even bps attributing cost vs gross absence; no sign inversion, no threshold/sigma-window rescue, no leg subset, no lower cost, no re-clocking. Anchor positive but the sign-shuffled control fires: the PnL is direction-irrelevant exposure (event-day beta or cost artifact), not leader information — reject regardless of anchor sign. Anchor positive but the USD-drift diagnostic fires: the edge is dollar-momentum continuation, and the re-centering claim is false — reject (this gate is expected to be a live, honest killer given the book's structural USD directionality). Anchor positive but incremental alpha <= 0: the trading law alone explains the book — reject. Neighbour diverges: trigger knife-edge between session-count definitions — not promotable. Drop-one or concentration failure: single-leg artifact — reject. Realized turnover below the 140-trade floor: INDETERMINATE (never negative evidence); unused slots are never reassigned.

control_identifiability_statement: Why a generic exposure form CANNOT silently pass: this family carries TWO preregistered killers aimed at its two confound classes. The sign-shuffled control retains trigger days, legs, holds and costs and destroys only the leader's SIGN — a direction-irrelevant exposure form (event-day beta, volatility-harvest, cost artifact) reproduces it and dies by CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM; a direction-aligned form that is really dollar momentum is killed by the inherited USD-drift diagnostic (|corr| > 0.30), which this packet declares a LIVE expected falsifier, not a formality. No arm can rescue the anchor: controls only falsify. This two-killer structure is designed against the E.2 cluster, where a single convenient control let an exposure-form pass.

margin_to_fail_expectations.fold_positive_share_and_concentration: Six legs give a structural floor of 0.167 for the max-pair share; expected max share 0.20-0.35 vs 0.40 — MODERATE margin. Fold-share gate expected inside 0.50. Kernel label definitions govern.
margin_to_fail_expectations.usd_drift_gate: DECLARED HIGH AND HONEST: the book is USD-directional on trigger days by construction, so this gate is the most likely single-gate failure (expected |corr| 0.15-0.45 vs the 0.30 ceiling). It is retained deliberately as the preregistered killer of the dollar-momentum explanation — a family that survives it earns that survival.
margin_to_fail_expectations.incremental_alpha_gt_0: Staleness (10 NY-days) strictly exceeds the diffusion window; expected margin a large fraction of anchor expectancy IF fresh-leader-driven. Residual risk: if EUR repricings cluster in persistent regimes, the stale trigger fires on overlapping states and erodes margin. THIN-POSITIVE.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_non_reproduction: Structurally the sign-shuffled control's expectancy is <= -costs, so firing requires a genuinely direction-irrelevant anchor — exactly the E.2 exposure-form the control exists to catch. MODERATE risk, intended.
